verdict.rationale: Formant documents its own pieces of this workflow: anomaly alerts (formant-docs-5), incident-response workflows for monitoring at scale (formant-docs-18), dispatching help when something looks wrong (formant-docs-17), peer-to-peer operator teleoperation (formant-docs-21) and intervention records (formant-docs-13). There is no documented human intervention queue that receives autonomy failures, and nothing on handing control back to autonomy; the durable message queue (formant-docs-52) carries commands to devices, not operator work items. missing for 10: an explicit operator intervention queue for autonomy failures, routing and assignment of interventions to operators, a documented hand-back-to-autonomy mechanism, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
